Class DentalRecords

java.lang.Object
DentalRecords
public class DentalRecords extends Object
Floridian Tooth Records. Records the teeth of one Florida family (maximum 6 people). Each person has an upper and a lower row of up to 8 teeth. The teeth are stored in a three-dimensional array of characters: plane = person, row = layer (upper or lower), column = tooth. A menu then lets the user print the records, extract a tooth, report the family's root canal indices, or exit.
Version:
1.1
Author:
Maggie Padavan
